controles.affirmation: Dette nette economique 46,14 Mds EUR au 31 mars 2026, "en hausse de 4,4 % depuis fin 2025 (43,24 Mds EUR)"
controles.verbatim_source: TRIM T1-2026, tableau : "Economic net debt (March 31, 2026, and December 31, 2025) | 46,140 | 43,236 | 7" (colonne de variation en %). Texte : "Economic net debt increased by EUR2.9 billion relative to year-end 2025 (EUR43.2 billion) to EUR46.1 billion."
controles.correction_proposee: +6,7 % (E.ON arrondit lui-meme a 7 % dans son tableau), et non +4,4 %. Les montants 46,14 et 43,24 Mds EUR sont exacts, seul le taux de variation est faux.

controles.affirmation: Contentieux concurrence classe "risque significatif, tail risk / niveau eleve" dans Energy Retail, seuil eleve = impact potentiel superieur a 2 Mds EUR
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025, section Energy Retail (colonne de gauche) : "Legal and regulatory risks/opportunities arise primarily from disputes over contract and price adjustments in the electricity and gas business. In addition, there are risks associated with allegations of anti-competitive practices, such as price fixing and market sharing. This poses a significant risk (tail risk/high). E.ON counters these risks by conducting comprehensive compliance management, continually monitoring regulatory developments, and taking preventive measures to ensure that its business activities comply with the law." Note 11 : "A risk is classified as 'high' if its potential impact exceeds EUR2 billion." Definition : "Tail risks and opportunities refer to risks and opportunities that are characterized by a very low probability of occurrence (less than 5 percent) but a high potential impact."
controles.correction_proposee: Affirmation exacte, rattachement au segment Energy Retail verifie (le paragraphe appartient bien a la colonne Energy Retail, non a Corporate Functions/Other), seuil 2 Mds EUR confirme par la note 11. La nuance ajoutee par l'ATT ("aucune sanction n'est a ce stade chiffree ni confirmee, il s'agit d'allegations sous surveillance de conformite") est fidele au document. Seule reserve de vocabulaire : le titre parle de "Contentieux", qui suggere une procedure en cours, alors que l'URD decrit une categorie de risque liee a des "allegations". Preferer "Risque concurrence classe...".

controles.affirmation: Passif minier : obligations en Rhenanie-du-Nord-Westphalie et en Baviere, probabilite d'occurrence estimee entre 6 et 25 %
controles.verbatim_source: "Health, safety, and environmental ('HSE') risks and opportunities as well as human resource risks and opportunities relate primarily to E.ON's responsibility for past mining activities in North Rhine-Westphalia and Bavaria. This results in obligations whose magnitude varies by region (6 to 25 percent likelihood of occurrence/material)."
controles.correction_proposee: Exact. Precision possible : ce risque est classe "material", pas "high".

controles.affirmation: 5e periode reglementaire allemande (electricite a partir de 2029, gaz a partir de 2028) reposant sur un cadre non encore finalise ; reseau suedois dans une situation comparable
controles.verbatim_source: "Germany's fifth regulatory period (power from 2029 onward, gas from 2028 onward) presents opportunities and risks resulting from the new regulatory framework, which has not yet been fully finalized (the Business Report chapter provides details on Germany's NEST process). E.ON's network business in Sweden faces a similar situation."

controles.affirmation: Energy Networks pese 7 695 M EUR sur 9 849 M EUR d'EBITDA ajuste groupe en 2025, soit 78 %
controles.verbatim_source: "The E.ON Group's adjusted EBITDA in fiscal year 2025 increased by EUR800 million to EUR9,849 million (prior year: EUR9,049 million)." ; "Energy Networks' adjusted EBITDA increased by EUR827 million to EUR7,695 million (prior year: EUR6,868 million)." 7 695/9 849 = 78,1 %.

controles.affirmation: Loi KRITIS approuvee par le Bundestag le 29 janvier 2026, couts additionnels non encore chiffrables
controles.verbatim_source: "On January 29, 2026, the German Bundestag approved the Umbrella Act for Critical Infrastructure (German acronym: 'KRITIS'), by which Germany transposed the EU CER Directive into national law. ... Specific requirements and investment needs will only be available after the completion of sector-specific regulations and a national risk assessment. Additional investments in structural security measures, access controls, and technical protection systems along with ongoing costs to operate, maintain, and monitor these systems and to fulfil reporting and documentation obligations are expected to pose risks."
controles.correction_proposee: Citation avec elision fidele. L'URD ajoute juste apres une phrase d'opportunites ("Opportunities could arise from uniform security standards, increased resilience, and efficiency gains") non reprise : acceptable dans une anti-these, mais a garder en tete.

controles.affirmation: Resultat net part du groupe 1,734 Md EUR (-61,7 %) ; resultat net consolide 2,28 Mds EUR (-59 %) ; BPA 0,66 EUR (-61,8 %) ; resultat net ajuste 3,022 Mds EUR (+5,8 %)
controles.verbatim_source: "Net income | 2,280 | 5,562 | Attributable to shareholders of E.ON SE | 1,734 | 4,531" ; "Group net income and corresponding earnings per share in the year under review amounted to EUR2,280 million and EUR0.66, respectively. Prior-year Group net income and earnings per share were EUR5,563 million and EUR1.73" ; "Group adjusted net income amounted to EUR3,022 in fiscal year 2025 (prior year: EUR2,856 million)." Calculs : 1 734/4 531 = -61,7 % ; 2 280/5 562 = -59,0 % ; 0,66/1,73 = -61,8 % ; 3 022/2 856 = +5,8 %.

controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres 25,833 Mds EUR fin 2025 ; ratio de fonds propres 23 % ; ROCE 8,9 % (+0,1 pt) ; investissements 8,51 Mds EUR (+13,5 %) ; charges d'interet nettes de 323 a 357 M EUR au T1 2026 ; notations BBB+, Baa2, BBB+
controles.verbatim_source: "Equity | 25,833 | 23 | 24,166 | 22" ; "E.ON's equity ratio at December 31, 2025, was 23 percent (prior year: 22 percent)." ; "ROCE improved slightly, from 8.8 percent in the prior year to 8.9 percent in 2025." ; tableau cinq ans "Cash-effective investments | 4,762 | 4,753 | 6,463 | 7,499 | 8,509" (8 509/7 499 = +13,5 %) ; "In the operating interest result, the net interest expense rose from EUR323 million to EUR357 million owing to an increase in economic net debt and higher refinancing costs." ; "E.ON's creditworthiness has been assessed by Standard & Poor's ('S&P'), Moody's, and Fitch Ratings with long-term ratings of BBB+, Baa2, and BBB+, respectively."
controles.correction_proposee: Tous exacts. Nuance de cadrage : l'ATT ecrit "le ratio de fonds propres reste limite a 23 %" alors que l'URD le presente en amelioration ("Equity ratio above prior year", 22 % a 23 %). Mentionner la progression.

controles.affirmation: Energy Retail apporte 52,4 Mds EUR sur 78,7 Mds EUR de chiffre d'affaires groupe (66,6 %)
controles.verbatim_source: Tableau segments, External sales 1.-4. Quartal : Energy Retail "52,405" ; "E.ON Group | 21,190 | 23,835 | -11 | 78,704 | 80,119 | -2". 52 405/78 704 = 66,6 %.

controles.affirmation: Dette nette economique fin 2025 de 43,24 Mds EUR, "elle-meme en hausse de 5,3 % sur un an"
controles.verbatim_source: "Economic net debt at December 31, 2025, amounted to EUR43.2 billion (prior year: EUR41.1 billion)." 43 236/41 060 = +5,3 %.

controles.affirmation: Defaut de forme : le bloc quantitatif "Rendement des capitaux employes" (ROCE 8,9 %, investissements 8,51 Mds EUR) ne comporte aucun champ "source"
controles.verbatim_source: Les deux chiffres sont verifies dans l'URD FY2025 (voir controle ROCE ci-dessus), mais le troisieme bloc de "quantitatif" est le seul du fichier depourvu de cle "source".
controles.correction_proposee: Ajouter le champ source : "URD FY2025 (2026-02-25), ROCE Performance in Fiscal Year 2025 et tableau cinq ans".
